title: By His Wounds We Are Healed

request.style: English, solemn female vocal solo with gentle choir support, piano, strings, cello, organ, reverent and sorrowful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A young shoot in the dry ground
No beauty to draw our eyes
He was despised and rejected
A man of sorrows and grief
We hid our faces from him
Holding him of no account
Yet he bore our heavy griefs
Carrying our deep sorrows

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment brought us peace
Laid upon his body
By his wounds we are healed
By his wounds we are healed

[Verse]
All of us have strayed like sheep
Turning to our own ways
The Lord laid all our sin
Upon his innocent soul
Oppressed and afflicted he stood
Yet did not open his mouth
Like a lamb to the slaughter
Silent before the shearers

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment brought us peace
Laid upon his body
By his wounds we are healed
By his wounds we are healed

[Verse]
Taken by judgment and oppression
Who gave it a thought in his generation
Cut off from the land of the living
Stricken for our transgression
He who knew no sin was led
To bear the weight of the world
The curse that was ours became his
The joy that is ours came from his pain

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment brought us peace
Laid upon his body
By his wounds we are healed
By his wounds we are healed

[Outro]
Healed by his wounds
Pierced for our sins
Healed by his wounds
